accepted_semantics: Pinned ≤8192-byte original start/terminal metadata; exact keys, strict integer versions/ordinals/counts, scope and owner, destination identity and original format.
Original positive capacity floor(8MiB/80), nonnegative start, and strict start+count<2**63. COMPLETE requires acknowledged=count and exactly count*80 body bytes; failed/pending tails outside API.

Every <Qd32s32s record validates exact global ordinal, finite float64 value in [0,1], 32 opaque purpose bytes and SHA-256 chain from original start hash; complete chain, entire body hash and EOF verified.
Fragmented reads progress by returned bytes; over-return, wrong type, early EOF and trailing data refuse. Reader exceptions propagate.
Duplicate JSON keys additionally refuse; canonical original writer emits no duplicates. Nonempty bounded terminal reason and negative zero remain valid original semantics.

independent_check.qualification: Fresh stdlib two-record reconstruction; no numerical imports or retained-data computation.

retained_author_tests.qualification: Original append AST and stdlib helper harness; no genuine Owner authority. Source and raw retained outputs inspected; suite not repeated.

minimal_next_requirement: A selected caller must authenticate original metadata/scope/owner and the complete tail roster, bind each ordinal/destination to that roster, and supply the existing bounded immutable-reader/deadline/transport lifecycle under separate genuine admission. This helper only validates supplied COMPLETE-tail content.

nonblocking_qualification.action: Use the precise contract in integration documentation; preserve the sealed author report.
nonblocking_qualification.issue: Short reads can make the sum of requested read(n) arguments exceed count*80+1. This is not a bound on cumulative request arguments.
nonblocking_qualification.precise_contract: Per request ≤80; actual bytes consumed ≤count*80+1 including EOF probe. Each nonempty body read makes progress; deadline and reader resource accounting are external.
